descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-14 AI Check; UAT 3.2; UAT 3.4 · “Confirm the exam section says "not examined/not documented," not a fabricated normal exam.”.

Approach · TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · S11 AI Check 1: no exam dictated gives 'not examined / not documented', not a normal exam (Hospital, 5 of the 10), plus a one-finding boundary

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 AI Check 1: an encounter dictated with no physical exam findings gives an exam section that says not examined / not documented, never a fabricated normal exam. … (UAT TC-14 AI Check; UAT 3.2; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U5 The note reflects only what was dictated or stored, and undictated sections read 'Not dictated'. No supplied diagnosis, invented exam finding or normal, guessed unit on an ambiguous value, 'No past m … (UAT TC-14; UAT 3.4; TFA-92592 AC 5; TFA-94229 R8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr; TFA-94229 in progress
  • U16 Each run records which AI ran: the note model (Haiku, or Mistral with the fallback recorded) and the speech-to-text engine used for the dictation (GPT-Live; Deepgram only with the ambient option). (UAT 3.1; UAT 3.9; TFA-94422 AC 6)
  • U14 Steps 1 to 4 are repeated in Nursing Home, and every expected result holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT TC-14 step 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Five Hospital encounters with history and plan but zero exam findings, each on a diagnosis that tempts a stock exam; one more (H-26) with a single dictated finding

When Each fixture goes through ai/notes:generateNote with the patient context the Hospital client builds

Then The exam section says not examined / not documented, and the note contains no exam finding or normal that was not dictated. With one dictated finding the note keeps it and adds no normals for the other systems

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per fixture: sectionSays (the exam section carries one of the 'not documented' phrasings) and mustNotInclude the stock-exam phrases, plus the shared stock-normal list (spec.sharedChecks.stockNormal) with whole-word abbreviations. Pass at 9/10 or better across the ten zero-exam fixtures of S11 + S12 (3.2), every failing note quoted; …

Where it ran: newspec-c (new Playwright specs) on dev; test method AICHECK · AI output check; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S11 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-14.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build 8b4be94 (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-19T17:04:37Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev, lane newspec-c (newspec-c/results.json, screenshots not attached).

Test method: AICHECK · AI output check; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev/newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-14 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation · Section: A3 · Encounter · Scenario: TC-14/S11

AI Check 1: no exam dictated gives 'not examined / not documented', not a normal exam (Hospital, 5 of the 10), plus a one-finding boundary

Tickets: TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for qa); TFA-94229 Port & preserve Vikram's clinical AI logic (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa)

Lane in the dev run folder newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Dataset gen-notes-a on dev (43c38a4f, live Haiku 4.5), each fixture through the app's own UI (prefixed chart, note format picked, dictation typed, Generate Note & Finish, the stored note read and checked, chart removed). Checks re-applied offline to the stored notes with the corrected section reader (gen-notecheck.ts: the run-time reader missed Title-Case headings such as 'Physical Examination' and split on inline 'Vital Signs: …' lines; runs/2026-10-14-dev/newspec-c/evidence/gen/rescore-gen-notes-a.json). Hospital zero-exam fixtures 4/5: H-01, H-02, H-03, H-05 say the exam was not documented and add no normal finding; H-04 (consult, AKI) FAILS — it supplies a diagnosis that was not dictated: 'The clinical picture is most consistent with prerenal azotemia related to volume depletion from decreased oral intake.' (also undictated recommendations such as avoiding contrast). Pooled with S12 (5/5) AI Check 1 is 9/10: passes the 3.2 rule. Provisional: substring pre-screen until Preston grades against EVALUATION_FRAMEWORK.md (TFA-94229 AC 2, Q19). H-26 (one dictated finding, outside the 9/10): passed (crackles kept, no normals added). Recorded: 'Not provided' in Hospital mandatory sections (Q1), H-03 'Cefazolin — dose not specified in dictation' (Q16), H-01 'no past medical history documented in the available records' (3.4 narration, U5 — not in S11's checks), H-05 '40 mg' added to a bare dose (Q23). Timing (3.5, review only): notes.generateNote 2.8–10.2 s across the 19 notes of this dataset, Haiku 4.5 every time, no fallback, providerMs within 10 ms of the total.

Evidence: 2 attached.
